summary.text: Brian Munroe is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 144, having taken office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Navy veteran and former police officer, he previously served on the Warminster Township board of supervisors and as Bucks County clerk of courts.

paragraphs.text: Munroe lives in Warminster, Pennsylvania, and served in the U.S. Navy.
His career includes work as a police officer in Radnor Township, where he reached the rank of corporal.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his public service began as a volunteer firefighter and EMT, and that it continued through the Navy, police work and elected office.
Munroe was elected to the Warminster Township board of supervisors and served as clerk of courts for Bucks County before joining the state House.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure, Insurance, Local Government, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness committees.

In the Ballotpedia survey, he named the rising cost of living, environmental protection, and defending rights and freedoms as key campaign messages, and said he sponsored legislation to set guardrails on AI data centers.
He described himself in the survey as the pro-choice candidate and said he supports measures to strengthen election security.
